def make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> list[int]:
    """Return n distinct record ids, the same list for the same seed."""
    pre n >= 0
    post out.len() == n
    post sorted({x for x in out}).len() == n
    ex make_ids(0, 7) == []
    ex make_ids(3, 7) == make_ids(3, 7)
    ex make_ids(3, 7).len() == 3
    start = (seed % 1000000007) * 1000
    out: list[int] = []
    for i in range(n):
        out.append(start + i)
    return out
